$comment: Single source of truth for the one finding tend-security reports per run. validate-finding.mjs reads this at runtime — do not duplicate these rules in prose. Unlike run-crucible's findings-schema.json (an array of findings), this schema describes exactly ONE finding object, matching SKILL.md's one-issue-per-run contract.

severity.description: Matches the priority ladder in references/scan-core.md.

title.description: Short human-readable name of the vulnerability, e.g. 'Timing-unsafe HMAC comparison in verifyToken'.

file.description: Path to the vulnerable file, relative to repo root (e.g. 'src/lib/hmac.ts'). Must exist on disk.

line.description: 1-indexed line number of the vulnerable code. Must be within the file's actual line count.

exploit.description: Concrete exploit path — how an attacker triggers it. Not a restatement of the title.

fix.description: The minimal fix applied, described specifically enough to verify against the diff.

verify.description: How a reviewer confirms the fix — a command to run, a request to replay, a test to check.
